name: FRAME 617
description: Frame 617 brings warm naturalness into the bathroom. The lacquered laminate front in olive wood texture looks calm and modern. Handle 262 in titanium colour discreetly complements the clear frame look. The body in white creates a fresh contrast. The top in greige Jura marble picks up on the natural look and has a high-quality feel.
